channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Inquest opens into death of Chandler's Ford man found dead in home
item.description: AN inquest has opened into the death of a Chandler's Ford man who was found dead at his home.

item.title: Money spent 'inappropriately' by parents to fund child's care
item.description: Money given to families to organise child social care arrangements was misspent in some cases, council audits found.

item.title: Plans submitted to New Forest District Council for 10 homes near Fordingbridge
item.description: A new application has been submitted to New Forest District Council proposing the outline development of ten dwellings near Fordingbridge.

item.title: All the locations one of the world's best cruise ships travels to from Southampton
item.description: Queen Mary 2 was named one of the world's best cruise ships for 2026 by Condé Nast Traveller, and here are all the destinations it travels to from Southampton

item.title: 'Family man' found with thousands of child abuse images avoids jail
item.description: A 'family man' who was found with thousands of indecent images of children, including videos over two hours long, has avoided jail

item.title: Petition launched for traffic calming on Butts Road after elderly man’s death
item.description: A petition has been launched calling for urgent traffic calming measures on a road in the city following the death of a 90-year-old man.

item.title: Two women charged after £300 of sportswear stolen from city centre store
item.description: Two women have been charged after more than £300 worth of sports clothing was stolen from a city centre store.

item.title: City shop announces closure due to owner's health issues
item.description: An art supply business has confirmed it will be closing soon

item.title: 'Horrendous' flooding and giant hole in the road has left a Hampshire pub despairing
item.description: A giant hole in the road and water coming through the floorboards has left a Hampshire village pub, The Farmer's Home, despairing over ‘horrendous’ flooding.

item.title: Student's family 'grateful' for support for memorial match after Southampton killing
item.description: The family of a student who was killed on a night out have praised the support they’ve received from the community, ahead of a charity football match.
